thesis: Christopher Zook describes his early career progression from commodities trading to brokerage roles at Payne Weber, Lehman Brothers, Prudential Securities, and Oppenheimer, noting that he eventually left the brokerage side to focus on asset management. He explains that he founded CAZ Investments in 2001 based on a goal set in 1991 to create a firm focused on managing money rather than brokerage, initially launching with separate accounts and a fund of hedge funds before evolving into a thematic investment model.
